in_marathi.name: Jaydeep
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jaydeep हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Sanskrit, Jaydeep means 'victorious deep'. This name holds significant importance in Hindu mythology, where Jay is a common prefix for various deities, and deep represents a deep sense of understanding, courage, and determination.
